landing.title: Pinneds
landing.tagline: One link. One board. Everyone's things, pinned.
landing.body: Upload a photo, we cut out the things in it, and friends pin them to a shared board. Nothing to install.
landing.step1: Share the board link with your people.
landing.step2: Everyone adds a photo; each thing in it becomes a pin.
landing.step3: Mix anyone's pins into brand-new scenes together.
landing.soon: Boards are almost here — existing links still work.
